root_idea.summary: The root's central image is looseness, slackening, or lack of compactness.
root_idea.development: From this physical image, Classical usage includes laxness and pendulousness, while related vocabulary denotes a requested or eagerly desired object. Form II usage is explained as making a desired thing appear attractive or easy, possibly through fulfilling a request or through the associated notion of laxness; the derivation is presented as possible rather than certain.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form سَوَّلَ.

senses.definition: To embellish a desired thing or affair for someone, making it seem good, acceptable, or easy, so that it becomes loved or approved.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of the soul's embellishing what a person eagerly desires and representing an objectionable aspect as good or harmless; the construction may take لِ with the person affected and an affair or thing as object.

senses.definition: To lead someone into error by enticement, or to facilitate indulgence in grave sins and appetites by making them seem desirable.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested construction used of the Devil's misleading and inciting a person; this is the agent-specific result of the embellishing described in the broader sense.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal form corresponding to سَأَلَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become lax, flaccid, or uncompact, or to hang down loosely and be pendulous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the belly or lower abdomen and, more broadly, to other things such as clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be imaged in the mind, become an object of fancy, or seem a certain way to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical construction describing something as mentally pictured or seeming to a person, distinct from the Quran-attested causative sense of embellishing a desired thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or beg one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal expression used of two persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A petition or request; also the thing requested or eagerly desired.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote either what is asked for or an object of want toward which the soul is strongly directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who asks or begs much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive description of a habitual or frequent asker.
A verbal noun also used substantivally for a request.
Used in the expression of being someone's equal in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lax, flaccid, or uncompact, or hanging down loosely and pendulous below.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person, especially the lower belly, and can describe uncompact clouds whose edges hang down.
A distinct nominal usage of the feminine form.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Embellishing and making a desired affair seem good or easy.
Devilish misleading and facilitation of sinful indulgence.
Petition, requested object, and eagerly desired object.
Lax or pendulous description and distinct bucket usage.
